arguments.sql:
WITH role_counts AS (
  SELECT player_id, role, COUNT(*) AS matches
  FROM main.player_match
  WHERE role IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY player_id, role
),
role_ranks AS (
  SELECT RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY player_id ORDER BY matches DESC) AS role_rank, player_id
  FROM role_counts
),
delivery_checks AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS deliveries,
         SUM(b.striker IS NULL) AS missing_striker,
         SUM(b.bowler IS NULL) AS missing_bowler,
         SUM(s.match_id IS NULL) AS missing_score_row,
         SUM(s.match_id IS NOT NULL AND s.runs_scored IS NULL) AS null_scores
  FROM main.ball_by_ball AS b
  LEFT JOIN main.batsman_scored AS s USING (match_id, over_id, ball_id, innings_no)
)
SELECT 'dismissal_kind' AS check_name, COALESCE(w.kind_out, '<NULL>') AS category,
       COUNT(*) AS records,
       SUM(b.match_id IS NULL) AS unmatched_deliveries,
       SUM(w.player_out IS NULL) AS missing_player
FROM main.wicket_taken AS w
LEFT JOIN main.ball_by_ball AS b USING (match_id, over_id, ball_id, innings_no)
GROUP BY w.kind_out
UNION ALL SELECT 'role', COALESCE(role, '<NULL>'), COUNT(*), NULL, NULL FROM main.player_match GROUP BY role
UNION ALL SELECT 'tied_top_role', NULL, COUNT(*), NULL, NULL
  FROM (SELECT player_id FROM role_ranks WHERE role_rank = 1 GROUP BY player_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1)
UNION ALL SELECT 'players', NULL, COUNT(*), NULL, NULL FROM main.player
UNION ALL SELECT 'players_without_match', NULL, COUNT(*), NULL, NULL
  FROM main.player AS p WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM main.player_match AS pm WHERE pm.player_id = p.player_id)
UNION ALL SELECT 'deliveries', NULL, deliveries, missing_striker, missing_bowler FROM delivery_checks
UNION ALL SELECT 'scores', NULL, missing_score_row, null_scores, NULL FROM delivery_checks;

WITH overs AS (
  SELECT b.match_id, b.innings_no, b.over_id, COUNT(*) AS deliveries, COUNT(s.match_id) AS score_rows
  FROM main.ball_by_ball AS b
  LEFT JOIN main.batsman_scored AS s USING (match_id, over_id, ball_id, innings_no)

),
ranked_overs AS (
  SELECT *, MAX(over_id) OVER (PARTITION BY match_id, innings_no) AS last_over
  FROM overs
)
SELECT 'full_over' AS check_type, deliveries, score_rows, COUNT(*) AS count_or_runs
FROM ranked_overs
WHERE over_id < last_over
GROUP BY deliveries, score_rows
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Kohli 2016', COUNT(*), COUNT(s.match_id), SUM(s.runs_scored)
FROM main.ball_by_ball AS b
JOIN main.player AS p ON p.player_id = b.striker
JOIN main."match" AS m ON m.match_id = b.match_id
LEFT JOIN main.batsman_scored AS s ON s.match_id = b.match_id
  AND s.innings_no = b.innings_no AND s.over_id = b.over_id AND s.ball_id = b.ball_id
WHERE p.player_name = 'V Kohli' AND m.season_id = 9;

arguments.sql:
WITH role_counts AS (
    SELECT player_id,
           role,
           SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (PARTITION BY player_id) AS total_matches_played,
           RANK() OVER (
               PARTITION BY player_id
               ORDER BY role IS NULL, COUNT(*) DESC
           ) AS role_rank
    FROM main.player_match
    GROUP BY player_id, role
),
appearances AS (
    SELECT player_id,
           GROUP_CONCAT(role, ', ') AS most_frequent_role,
           MAX(total_matches_played) AS total_matches_played
    FROM (
        SELECT player_id, role, total_matches_played
        FROM role_counts
        WHERE role_rank = 1
        ORDER BY player_id, role
    )
    GROUP BY player_id
),
batting_by_match AS (
    SELECT b.striker AS player_id,
           b.match_id,
           SUM(s.runs_scored) AS runs_scored,
           COUNT(*) AS balls_faced
    FROM main.ball_by_ball AS b
    JOIN main.batsman_scored AS s USING (match_id, over_id, ball_id, innings_no)
    GROUP BY b.striker, b.match_id
),
batting_career AS (
    SELECT player_id,
           SUM(runs_scored) AS total_runs_scored,
           MAX(runs_scored) AS highest_score,
           SUM(runs_scored >= 30) AS matches_with_30_plus,
           SUM(runs_scored >= 50) AS matches_with_50_plus,
           SUM(runs_scored >= 100) AS matches_with_100_plus,
           SUM(balls_faced) AS total_balls_faced
    FROM batting_by_match
    GROUP BY player_id
),
dismissals AS (
    SELECT player_out AS player_id,
           COUNT(*) AS total_dismissals
    FROM main.wicket_taken
    WHERE kind_out <> 'retired hurt'
    GROUP BY player_out
),
bowling_by_match AS (
    SELECT b.bowler AS player_id,
           b.match_id,
           SUM(COALESCE(s.runs_scored, 0)) AS runs_given,
           -- Count recorded deliveries for economy while ignoring the extra-runs data.
           COUNT(*) AS balls_bowled,
           COUNT(CASE WHEN w.kind_out IN (
               'bowled', 'caught', 'caught and bowled', 'hit wicket', 'lbw', 'stumped'
           ) THEN 1 END) AS wickets_taken
    FROM main.ball_by_ball AS b
    LEFT JOIN main.batsman_scored AS s USING (match_id, over_id, ball_id, innings_no)
    LEFT JOIN main.wicket_taken AS w USING (match_id, over_id, ball_id, innings_no)
    GROUP BY b.bowler, b.match_id
),
bowling_career AS (
    SELECT player_id,
           wickets_taken || '-' || runs_given AS best_bowling_performance,
           SUM(wickets_taken) OVER player_matches AS total_wickets_taken,
           SUM(runs_given) OVER player_matches AS total_runs_given,
           SUM(balls_bowled) OVER player_matches AS total_balls_bowled,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               PARTITION BY player_id
               ORDER BY wickets_taken DESC, runs_given, match_id
           ) AS performance_rank
    FROM bowling_by_match
    WINDOW player_matches AS (PARTITION BY player_id)
)
SELECT p.player_id,
       p.player_name,
       a.most_frequent_role,
       p.batting_hand,
       p.bowling_skill,
       COALESCE(bt.total_runs_scored, 0) AS total_runs_scored,
       COALESCE(a.total_matches_played, 0) AS total_matches_played,
       COALESCE(d.total_dismissals, 0) AS total_dismissals,
       1.0 * COALESCE(bt.total_runs_scored, 0) / NULLIF(d.total_dismissals, 0) AS batting_average,
       bt.highest_score,
       COALESCE(bt.matches_with_30_plus, 0) AS matches_with_30_plus,
       COALESCE(bt.matches_with_50_plus, 0) AS matches_with_50_plus,
       COALESCE(bt.matches_with_100_plus, 0) AS matches_with_100_plus,
       COALESCE(bt.total_balls_faced, 0) AS total_balls_faced,
       100.0 * bt.total_runs_scored / NULLIF(bt.total_balls_faced, 0) AS strike_rate,
       COALESCE(bw.total_wickets_taken, 0) AS total_wickets_taken,
       6.0 * bw.total_runs_given / NULLIF(bw.total_balls_bowled, 0) AS economy_rate,
       bw.best_bowling_performance
FROM main.player AS p
LEFT JOIN appearances AS a ON a.player_id = p.player_id
LEFT JOIN batting_career AS bt ON bt.player_id = p.player_id
LEFT JOIN dismissals AS d ON d.player_id = p.player_id
LEFT JOIN bowling_career AS bw ON bw.player_id = p.player_id AND bw.performance_rank = 1
ORDER BY p.player_id

SQL: WITH role_counts AS (
    SELECT player_id,
           role,
           SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (PARTITION BY player_id) AS total_matches_played,
           RANK() OVER (
               PARTITION BY player_id
               ORDER BY role IS NULL, COUNT(*) DESC
           ) AS role_rank
    FROM main.player_match
    GROUP BY player_id, role
),
appearances AS (
    SELECT player_id,
           GROUP_CONCAT(role, ', ') AS most_frequent_role,
           MAX(total_matches_played) AS total_matches_played
    FROM (
        SELECT player_id, role, total_matches_played
        FROM role_counts
        WHERE role_rank = 1
        ORDER BY player_id, role
    )
    GROUP BY player_id
),
batting_by_match AS (
    SELECT b.striker AS player_id,
           b.match_id,
           SUM(s.runs_scored) AS runs_scored,
           COUNT(*) AS balls_faced
    FROM main.ball_by_ball AS b
    JOIN main.batsman_scored AS s USING (match_id, over_id, ball_id, innings_no)
    GROUP BY b.striker, b.match_id
),
batting_career AS (
    SELECT player_id,
           SUM(runs_scored) AS total_runs_scored,
           MAX(runs_scored) AS highest_score,
           SUM(runs_scored >= 30) AS matches_with_30_plus,
           SUM(runs_scored >= 50) AS matches_with_50_plus,
           SUM(runs_scored >= 100) AS matches_with_100_plus,
           SUM(balls_faced) AS total_balls_faced
    FROM batting_by_match
    GROUP BY player_id
),
dismissals AS (
    SELECT player_out AS player_id,
           COUNT(*) AS total_dismissals
    FROM main.wicket_taken
    WHERE kind_out <> 'retired hurt'
    GROUP BY player_out
),
bowling_by_match AS (
    SELECT b.bowler AS player_id,
           b.match_id,
           SUM(COALESCE(s.runs_scored, 0)) AS runs_given,
           -- Count recorded deliveries for economy while ignoring the extra-runs data.
           COUNT(*) AS balls_bowled,
           COUNT(CASE WHEN w.kind_out IN (
               'bowled', 'caught', 'caught and bowled', 'hit wicket', 'lbw', 'stumped'
           ) THEN 1 END) AS wickets_taken
    FROM main.ball_by_ball AS b
    LEFT JOIN main.batsman_scored AS s USING (match_id, over_id, ball_id, innings_no)
    LEFT JOIN main.wicket_taken AS w USING (match_id, over_id, ball_id, innings_no)
    GROUP BY b.bowler, b.match_id
),
bowling_career AS (
    SELECT player_id,
           wickets_taken || '-' || runs_given AS best_bowling_performance,
           SUM(wickets_taken) OVER player_matches AS total_wickets_taken,
           SUM(runs_given) OVER player_matches AS total_runs_given,
           SUM(balls_bowled) OVER player_matches AS total_balls_bowled,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               PARTITION BY player_id
               ORDER BY wickets_taken DESC, runs_given, match_id
           ) AS performance_rank
    FROM bowling_by_match
    WINDOW player_matches AS (PARTITION BY player_id)
)
SELECT p.player_id,
       p.player_name,
       a.most_frequent_role,
       p.batting_hand,
       p.bowling_skill,
       COALESCE(bt.total_runs_scored, 0) AS total_runs_scored,
       COALESCE(a.total_matches_played, 0) AS total_matches_played,
       COALESCE(d.total_dismissals, 0) AS total_dismissals,
       1.0 * COALESCE(bt.total_runs_scored, 0) / NULLIF(d.total_dismissals, 0) AS batting_average,
       bt.highest_score,
       COALESCE(bt.matches_with_30_plus, 0) AS matches_with_30_plus,
       COALESCE(bt.matches_with_50_plus, 0) AS matches_with_50_plus,
       COALESCE(bt.matches_with_100_plus, 0) AS matches_with_100_plus,
       COALESCE(bt.total_balls_faced, 0) AS total_balls_faced,
       100.0 * bt.total_runs_scored / NULLIF(bt.total_balls_faced, 0) AS strike_rate,
       COALESCE(bw.total_wickets_taken, 0) AS total_wickets_taken,
       6.0 * bw.total_runs_given / NULLIF(bw.total_balls_bowled, 0) AS economy_rate,
       bw.best_bowling_performance
FROM main.player AS p
LEFT JOIN appearances AS a ON a.player_id = p.player_id
LEFT JOIN batting_career AS bt ON bt.player_id = p.player_id
LEFT JOIN dismissals AS d ON d.player_id = p.player_id
LEFT JOIN bowling_career AS bw ON bw.player_id = p.player_id AND bw.performance_rank = 1
ORDER BY p.player_id
LIMIT 1000
